Gruppi spaziali, celle e stechiometria dei cocristalli non sono nel testo (Tabelle S2 e S3, supplementare): le stechiometrie dei cocristalli sono lasciate null (le preparazioni usano quantita' equimolari). Non sono eventi: il 30% circa dei cristalli di 5FC-C14 piu' corti di 100 µm non si muove ma si espande (II-III senza moto); le cricche dei cristalli che si spaccano seguono [010]; il disordine delle catene alchiliche che cresce con T («noticeable disorder occuring near transition temperature»); la dipendenza dalla taglia (i piccoli saltano o ruotano, i grandi esplodono). Le risposte termomeccaniche sono «largely unaffected by varying heating rates (Figure S14)». Il testo dice che il punto di fusione aumenta e la solubilita' diminuisce con la lunghezza della catena (Figure S32 e S33): niente numeri nel testo. citazioni: In contrast, the II‐III phase transition followed a cooperative mechanism. 5FC‐C14 form II underwent a rapid, single‐crystal‐to‐single‐crystal transition characterized by swift changes in birefringence (Figure 1C; Figure S11 and Movies S1 and S2, Supporting Information). The morphology and birefringence of the crystal were fully restored upon cooling, confirming the reversibility of this transformation.
A total of 50 individual 5FC‐C14 crystals were analyzed using a hot stage microscope at a heating rate of 20 K min−1.
Thermal profiles of phase transitions in 5FC‐C2n cocrystals, monitored by DSC with a 10 K min−1 heating/cooling rate.
Moreover, single‐crystal DSC revealed a “sawtooth” transition peak profile, indicative of thermosalient effects (Figure 1G; Figure S6, Supporting Information).
Upon heating from 160 to 260 K, α decreases slightly to 68.3° (Figure S21, Supporting Information).
A perspective view of the layer packing mode of 5FC‐C14 form II at 160 K and form III at 323 K.
However, during the transition from form II to form III, the molecular layers undergo a dramatic reorientation toward the (001) plane, with α decreasing significantly to 47.3° (Figure 4A).

This reorientation induces notable anisotropic volume changes in the crystal: a significant expansion (+64.4%) along the layer stacking directions and a contraction perpendicular to the (001) plane (−16.9%) (Figure 4A).
These observations revealed a range of behaviors, including expanding, rotating, jumping, splitting, and combinations thereof (Figure 2D–H).

Analysis of size‐dependent behavior (Figure 2A) showed that smaller crystals typically rotated or jumped while maintaining their crystal integrity, whereas larger crystals were more likely to exhibit explosive behavior.
The results indicate that the phase transition occurs extremely rapidly, and the thermomechanical responses were largely unaffected by varying heating rates (Figure S14, Supporting Information).

Importantly, at temperatures near T t, II‐III, crystal movement was observed during both heating and cooling cycles (Figures S12 and S13, Supporting Information), as detailed in the following section.
In contrast, form II underwent a first‐order endothermic transition (II to III) before melt (Figure S5, Supporting Information).

eventi.note: Transizione II -> III di 5FC-C14, studiata su cristalli singoli: microscopia a piastra calda (20 K/min, 50 cristalli), DSC su cristallo singolo (10 K/min, profilo «a dente di sega») e SCXRD (form II a 160 K; riscaldando da 160 a 260 K l'angolo α scende appena da 68.8° a 68.3°; form III a 323 K con α = 47.3°). Temperatura: l'articolo non da' la T t di C14 nel testo (Fig. 1F); la forma III e' vista a 323 K e l'ultima struttura ancora di form II e' a 260 K (lettura del testo, Fig. S21): valore 323, min 260 (osservata). Velocita': 10 K/min per il DSC, 20 K/min per la HSM. Espansione +64.4% lungo la direzione di impilamento degli strati e contrazione -16.9% perpendicolare al piano (001); espansioni del parallelogramma 15.4% e 9.5% lungo i bordi. Cristalli piu' piccoli: ruotano o saltano restando interi; i grandi esplodono e si spaccano (cricche lungo [010]). Reversibile: morfologia e birifrangenza ripristinate al raffreddamento, moto osservato in riscaldamento e raffreddamento; nessuna condizione di ritorno data, un solo evento. 'First-order' dalla frase sul DSC della form II (Fig. S5).

citazioni: In contrast, form II underwent a first‐order endothermic transition (II to III) before melt (Figure S5, Supporting Information). The II‐III phase transition was reversible during heating and cooling cycles (Figure 1E).

Thermal profiles of phase transitions in 5FC‐C2n cocrystals, monitored by DSC with a 10 K min−1 heating/cooling rate. E) DSC curves of powder samples of 5FC‐C2n cocrystal form II. All cocrystals exhibit a reversible transition.

DSC measurements were conducted with a TA Instrument Q2000 unit under 50 mL min−1 nitrogen gas purge. Accurately weighed samples (5–10 mg) were placed in sealed aluminum pans and heated from 200 K to the desired temperature at heating/cooling rate of 1, 5, 10, and 20 K min−1.

Interestingly, the transition temperature (T t, II‐III) was highly sensitive to alkyl chain length, with T t, II‐III spanning ≈100 K (250 to 350 K) as chain length increased from C10 to C18 (Figure 1F).
Similar to 5FC‐C14 cocrystals, other cocrystals also exhibit intense thermosalient effects (Figure S16 and Movies S11–S14, Supporting Information), which is consistent with the DSC characterization.

Crystal structure analysis revealed that form II, across varying alkyl chain lengths, is isomorphous, with the lattice parameter c systematically increasing as the alkyl chain length increases (Figure 3C). This suggests a consistent cooperative transition mechanism across the 5FC‐C2n systems.

Valore puntuale nella Fig. 1F. Per 5FC-C10 anche «Similar expansion (+54.1% along the layer stacking directions) and uniaxial contraction (−24.1% perpendicular to the (001) plane) were also observed ... during its II-III phase transition». Polvere di form II, DSC 10 K/min (didascalia della Fig. 1): transizione endotermica del primo ordine, reversibile in riscaldamento e raffreddamento; nessuna condizione di ritorno data, un solo evento.

preparazioni.rapporto_soluzione: 5FC : fatty acid equimolar (6.4545 g 5FC, 0.05 mol, in 1 L)
preparazioni.pretrattamento: soluzione riscaldata a 320 K fino a completa dissoluzione
citazioni: Cocrystal form I was prepared by the slow solvent evaporation method. A solution of 6.4545 g 5FC (0.05 mol) and an equimolar amount of fatty acids (C14, C16, and C18) was added to 1 L acetonitrile‐methanol (1/3, v/v) mixed solvent and heated to 320 K until the components were completely dissolved. Single crystals were obtained by allowing the solvent to evaporate slowly at room temperature. Powder samples were prepared by grinding the single crystals.
preparazioni.note: Form I di C14, C16 e C18. Le polveri si ottengono macinando i monocristalli.

citazioni: 5FC‐C12 form I can be prepared through a slurry method in an ice water bath, 5FC‐C10 form I have not been prepared yet.
5FC‐C12 form I can be prepared through a slurry method in an ice water bath, 5FC‐C10 form I have not been prepared yet.
preparazioni.note: «5FC-C10 form I have not been prepared yet»: la forma I di 5FC-C10 non e' stata ottenuta (il testo non dice con quali tentativi).

preparazioni.rapporto_soluzione: 5FC : fatty acid equimolar (1.2909 g 5FC, 0.01 mol, in 50 mL acetonitrile)
citazioni: Powders of form II/III were prepared using a slurry method. To a round‐bottom flask, 1.2909 g 5FC (0.01 mol) and an equimolar amount of fatty acids (C10, C12, C14, C16, and C18) were added to 50 mL acetonitrile, and the slurry was stirred at 350 K for 1 h. After cooling to room temperature, the products were filtered and dried in a vacuum oven for 12 h. Starting with a 3.5 g input of the compositions (5FC + C14), ≈3 g of the cocrystal product was obtained, yielding an actual production rate of ≈85%.
preparazioni.note: Sospensione di 5FC e acido grasso in acetonitrile; la polvere e' «form II/III» (etichetta collettiva). Seccata in forno a vuoto per 12 h. Resa ≈85% per 5FC + C14.

citazioni: Single crystals of 5FC‐C10/C12/C14/C16/C18 form II/III were obtained by slow evaporation from a 5FC and fatty acid (equimolar ratio) solution in acetonitrile‐water (5/1, v/v) mixed solvent at 340 K.
Single crystals of 5FC‐C6/C8 were prepared by slow evaporation from a 5FC and fatty acid (Mole ratio, 1:100) solution in acetonitrile‐water (5/1, v/v) mixed solvent at room temperature.

descrizioni.testo: fully extended conformation of the fatty acid molecules in the 5FC-C2n cocrystals, forming sandwich-like alkyl bilayers
descrizioni.citazione: The fatty acid molecules interact with these aromatic ribbons via COO─H···O bonds and adopt a fully extended conformation, forming sandwich‐like alkyl bilayers (Figure S17, Supporting Information).

descrizioni.testo: only minor conformational changes between forms II and III, despite increased thermal motion of the chains at elevated temperature
descrizioni.citazione: However, structural analysis shows that, despite these increased motions, only minor conformational changes occur during the phase transition, as evidenced by the molecular overlap in forms II and III (Figure S30, Supporting Information).
